summary: Short park-edge kerb on Underhill Avenue where cars already park; homes over 30 m away.
reasons: Other cars park along this kerb

best_section.where: West kerb of the short Underhill Avenue cul-de-sac, beside the park, north of the main road

drivers.seclusion: West side is park lawn and dense shrubs. Nearest mapped dwelling is 31 m (apartments) at the far end; a petrol station is 28 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, with cars parked along the kerb in both images. Room for a van among them.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end spur off a busier road; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked on this kerb in both Esri and QLD images, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Apartment blocks across the road, 30 to 60 m away
Max local grade 7.3% in one 5 m step, mean 2.4%
sun_shade: Mostly open on the east side; trees to the west give afternoon shade. Some canopy over the south end.
